title: Crash Course: Odoo ERP
tagline: Understand how CRM, Sales, Inventory, delivery, invoicing, and payments connect through one practical Odoo workflow.
description: This course is the main entry point for students, fresh graduates, employees, business owners, and future ERP professionals who need more than isolated software tutorials.
Learners follow one connected business story across Odoo applications, building both system confidence and a practical understanding of how departments exchange information.
learningOutcomes: Explain the purpose and value of ERP systems
Configure a small product catalog and stock movements
Understand how business departments share records and responsibilities
Choose an appropriate next Odoo learning track
whoItsFor: Students and graduates building a practical ERP foundation before choosing a specialization
ERP beginners who want to enter Odoo without getting lost in technical complexity
Office professionals who need to understand the workflows behind daily administrative work
Career explorers evaluating functional, administrative, or technical Odoo directions
requirements: No prior ERP or Odoo experience
Basic digital literacy and browser use
Interest in business processes and technology
A laptop or desktop for practical activities

curriculum.title: Introduction to ERP and Odoo
curriculum.description: Understand what ERP systems are, why organizations use them, and how Odoo connects departments.

curriculum.title: CRM and Sales Workflow
curriculum.description: Follow leads, opportunities, quotations, and sales orders through a realistic sales process.

curriculum.title: Inventory Basics
curriculum.description: Explore products, warehouses, stock movements, receipts, deliveries, and availability.

curriculum.title: Accounting Flow Overview
curriculum.description: Understand invoices, payments, commercial documents, and their connection to operations.

curriculum.title: Complete Business Scenario
curriculum.description: Apply the full customer journey from enquiry and quotation through sale, delivery, invoice, and payment.

projects.title: Lead-to-Cash Scenario
projects.description: Process a customer opportunity through sales, stock delivery, invoicing, and payment.

projects.title: Product and Stock Setup
projects.description: Create a small product catalog and complete receipt and delivery movements.

projects.title: ERP Process Map
projects.description: Visualize how information moves between Sales, Inventory, and Accounting.

faq.question: How is this different from the Odoo User Guide?
faq.answer: The User Guide focuses on daily usage habits, while this course explains the larger ERP picture through a structured, connected business scenario.

faq.question: Is accounting knowledge required?
faq.answer: No. The course introduces the operational meaning of invoices and payments without requiring advanced accounting.

faq.question: Will I work in a real Odoo environment?
faq.answer: The planned delivery includes guided practice in an Odoo training environment.

faq.question: What comes after this course?
faq.answer: System Admin is a strong operational next step; Implementation suits functional learners; Development suits technical learners.
